chunks: Among the sayings of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام upon sighting the crescent was:

O obedient creation, tireless, swift, revolving in the orbit of governance, moving through the stations of decree. I believe in the One who illuminated the darkness by you, lit up obscurities through you, and made you a sign among the signs of His authority. He tested you with increase and decrease, rising and setting, illumination and eclipse. In all of that, you are obedient to Him and swift toward His will. Glorified is He—how excellent what He has arranged, and how precise what He has made in His dominion. May Allah make you the crescent of a new month for a new matter; may Allah make you a crescent of security, faith, safety, and Islam, a crescent of protection from afflictions and safety from evil deeds:

O Allah, make us the most guided of those upon whom it rises, and the purest of those who look at it. And may Allah bless Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, the Prophet, and his family. O Allah, do for me such-and-such and such-and-such, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

key_terms.آيَةً: a sign pointing to Allah’s power and authority
key_terms.الزِّيَادَةِ وَالنُّقْصَانِ: the moon’s increase and decrease through its phases
key_terms.الْهِلالِ: the crescent moon marking the beginning of the month
key_terms.فَلَكِ التَّدْبِيرِ: the orbit of divine arrangement and governance
key_terms.مَنَازِلِ التَّقْدِيرِ: the measured stations determined by divine decree

ai.seo_question: What did Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام say when sighting the crescent moon?
ai.summary: This supplication from Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام at the sighting of the crescent reflects on the moon as a sign of Allah’s power, order, and decree. It combines contemplation of creation with du'a for guidance, purity, security, and faith at the beginning of a new month.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1847 - Among the sayings of Amir al-Mu'minin (as) upon sighting the crescent was:

"O obedient creation, tireless, swift, revolving in the orbit of decreed management, moving through the stages of measured determination. I believe in the One who brightened the darkness with you, illuminated obscurities through you, and made you a sign among the signs of His sovereignty. He subjected you to increase and decrease, rising and setting, illumination and eclipse. In all of this, you remain obedient to Him and quick to fulfill His will. Glory be to Him! How excellent is His management, and how perfect is His craftsmanship in His dominion.
May Allah (swt) make you the crescent of a new month for a new matter, a crescent of security, faith, peace, and submission, a crescent free from calamities and safe from sins.

O Allah (swt), make us the most rightly guided of those upon whom it rises and the purest of those who gaze upon it. Blessings of Allah (swt) be upon Muhammad, the Prophet, and his family. O Allah (swt), do for me [such-and-such] O Most Merciful of the merciful!"
